record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, reduce only the tied normalized item-embedding radius multiplier from 0.8 to 0.65, retaining width 64 and input/output tying. A smaller radius may regularize catalog representations and reduce overconfident masked-item predictions. Keep frequency features, attention, history, loss temperature and optimizer fixed; use the same radius in training and prediction.
